It began on 12 February 2012 and ended on 20 November 2012.{{cite web|title=Congo DR - Linafoot 2012|url=https://int.soccerway.com/national/congo-dr/super-ligue/2012/regular-season/r17141/|publisher=soccerway.com|accessdate=20 November 2012}} During the mid-season break it was decided the second half of the season would consist of 10 rounds of matches only; 3 entire rounds were cancelled. ==Clubs== A total of 14 teams are contesting the league, played under a round-robbin format.{{cite web|title=Division1: le calendrier est connu|url=https://www.radiookapi.net/sport/2012/01/29/division1-le-calendrier-est-connu|publisher=radiookapi.net|accessdate=29 January 2012}} {{Location map+ |Democratic Republic of the Congo|width=410 |float=right |alt=Map of the Democratic Republic of the Congo with the teams of the 2012 Linafoot |caption=Locations of teams in the 2012 Linafoot|places= {{Location map~ |Democratic Republic of the Congo |lat=-11.704634 |long=27.484016 |position=left|label=[[FC Saint Eloi Lupopo|Lupopo]]}} {{Location map~ |Democratic Republic of the Congo |lat=-1.677694 |long=29.227083 |position=top|label=[[DC Virunga]]}} {{Location map~ |Democratic Republic of the Congo |lat=0.047778 |long=18.255833 |position=top|label=[[TP Molunge]]}} {{Location map~ |Democratic Republic of the Congo |lat=-5.038611 |long=18.818056 |position=top|label=[[AS Vutuka]]}} {{Location map~ |Democratic Republic of the Congo |lat=-2.95 |long=25.95 |position=left|label=[[AC Nkoy]]}} {{Location map~ |Democratic Republic of the Congo |lat=-5.841535 |long=13.060365 |position=top|label=[[TC Elima|Elima]]}} {{Location map~ |Democratic Republic of the Congo |lat=0.521232 |long=25.186404 |position=top|label=[[CS Makiso]]}} {{Location map~ |Democratic Republic of the Congo |lat=-4.330311 |long=15.310328 |position=top|label=[[Daring Club Motema Pembe|Motema]]
